notes.title: Pixelot Graphic Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hey friends. I have updated Pixelot with tons of new graphics both on the steam page as well as in game. This update replaced the opening banner and adds banners to every location and for import character appearances. These banners really help to see the world of Pixelot in a brand new way! I have also fixed lots of bugs and taken feedback for scaling and making the game more fun!

With the new price, this is the best time to try out this classic, nostalgic RPG!

notes.title: Graphic Update
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

In this update I have updated the feature graphics for the application and added additional banners at each location you visit. You will also be presented with banners the first time you meet an important character.

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes: Bug fixes to typos, and keyboard interactions

notes.title: Controller Support Updates
notes.notes:
- Fixed incorrect text in tutorial referring to party / unit menu instead of army menu
- Fixed controller support for targeting
- Fixed a bug that caused you to attack no one when the boss was dead
- Added outline to targeting windows

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.notes: Hello! I have added controller support to the game. Please send all issues you find to berger.msn@gmail.com so I can fix them as soon as I can! I hope you like the update!

notes.title: Pet Fixes
notes.notes: Quick update to fix some bugs related to pets and boss fights. Also fixed not being able to click on the light crystal when trying to heal it in the crystal sanctum. Finally fixed a bug where resetting your tower level did not change what map you entered when going back into the tower.

notes.title: Achievements and Light Crystals
notes.notes:
- Fixed achievement bugs including protect, promote, and prisma
- Added Light Crystal system to dark tower after floor 100 to allow you to increase your stats

notes.title: Bug Fixes for Lich and Pets
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug where game would crash when the first character to act was killed by spell reflect (Lich Fight)
- Fixed bug where a soul blade uses a revive would sometimes crash
- Fixed bug where a hunter using "Mark" on targets 5 or 6 would crash
- Added 3 new skin tones to the character creation screen
- Progress on keyboard support. Nearly done the menu screen

notes.title: Fixed Stat bug
notes.notes: Characters not in current party were endlessly promoting after each battle causing them to gain unnaturally large stats

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Full Screen
notes.notes:
I have fixed bugs relating to the barber shop, loading assets, and the altrius weapon.

I have also added fullscreen as an option. Press f11 to enter into full screen mode. You can also set this in the config window inside the game menu.

Will be working on controller support! Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Inspired by Pokemon and Final Fantasy, Pixelot is an RPG labour of love
notes.notes:
Developing games is hard work when it's your full-time job - and it's harder still when you have to fit it into an already packed schedule of being a parent and holding down a full-time job doing something completely different. Kyle Berger has made it work, however - he's used his love for classic RPG games like Final Fantasy and Pokemon during weekend nights as his family slept to create Pixelot, a love letter to old school role-playing games.

Pixelot has just launched on Steam, and it's got all the best components of the classics: there are multiple character classes to pick from, a roster of recruitable NPCs, a leveling system that goes up to 60, 15 unique dungeons, and some 500 items to collect. As a newly awakened hero, you're called upon to help stop an evil prince from escaping a magical prison he's been banished to, and your adventure will take you across 250 different maps full of turn-based JRPG battles.

It's a decidedly low-fi affair, but it's got plenty of charm and is steeped in Berger's own sense of humour - plus lots of references to the Pokemon and Zelda series, among others, from which it unabashedly draws its inspiration.
